translations.web: Yahweh your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.
translations.bsb: The LORD your God has multiplied you, so that today you are as numerous as the stars in the sky.
translations.kjv: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
translations.asv: Jehovah your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
